text: Funny Kid Central, Episode One. Welcome. Nina watched the other second graders run outside. Their parents were picking them up. But Nina's mom worked late. So Nina was going to Kid Central. Nina walked into the gym. She wished she could go home and play in her backyard. A big banner over the windows read, "After School Fun and Games at Kid Central." Nina didn't.
